scope: Four-route OaPA ONLY: no external baseline training or evaluation; retain datasets, protocols, components, aggregation, and reference controls

all_view_extension.metric: Within each seed, arithmetic mean of seven per-view Macro-F1 scores; then average three seeds; percent
all_view_extension.not_equivalent_to: TVA-only, pooled predictions, or P1 mixed-mask score
all_view_extension.aggregation_expert_control: All seven rows share identical fixed singleton A/V overrides; Backbone disables neural aggregation only; OaPA F_all must match MAIN_P0 F_all

P0_selection: Final J, earliest max equal-view Macro-F1 after singleton expert replacement, before VPA
P1_selection: Final J, earliest max mean Macro-F1 of ten fixed D_val mixed-mask populations AFTER expert replacement, before VPA; never weighted sum of per-view F1
training_stage_selection: Teachers/A/B keep original selection; only final J uses deployed expert routing
P0_gate_calibration: All legal calibration views, class-balanced BCE + .2 visible-branch-weight penalty
P1_gate_calibration: Ten fixed calibration masks at same p; original matched-p gate fitter generalized to reg.2
gate: AdamW lr.03 wd.02 200steps seed31337; missing branch weight zero
expert_scope: A-only or V/I-only masks only; all joint views and T-only retain frozen backbone+VPA
expert_sharing: One new bank per dataset, shared across network seeds and p; no old weights reused
checkpoint_retention: User override 2026-10-31: keep all J epochs temporarily for deployed selection, then retain selected model, gates, raw model, three-seed predictions and logs; prune only this campaign run ephemeral J/stage/resume checkpoints after successful selection/calibration
D_probe: Unused by this campaign; excluded from paper sample totals, fitting and selection
PF_MyGO: N/A exactly as current paper; no invented no-event result
PF_calibration: D_val61 reused for selection/calibration per original protocol, not an independent set
test_policy: Global implementation/config/checkpoint/expert/gate/mask freeze BEFORE any new D_test evaluation; historical exposure remains disclosed
default_execution: Disabled; training queue defaults to preview and requires completed M0 readiness
reference_presentation: Two rows S-random / Semantic (DCR), two result columns SV / TT; three-seed mean P0 F_all (%); no figure export
input_dimension_note: Use unchanged cache and current paper shapes. Earlier user wording 786 dimensions conflicts with current manuscript 384/512/768; resolve provenance in M0 before execution, never silently reshape or substitute features.
external_baselines: Existing paper values left unchanged; no fresh inference or pooled cross-campaign statistics
